method: damped local trend on log median price per square metre
benchmark: seasonal naive: next January looks like last January
sql: select area_key, date_trunc('month', ts) as month, median(price_per_sqm) as ppsqm, count(*) as n from transactions where price_per_sqm is not null group by 1, 2 having count(*) >= 3 order by 1, 2
